    Convenience
    • Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
    Safety and Security
    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
    • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane.   • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.

  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

We invite you to visit and experience this WRX firsthand.

This 2020 Genesis G70 3.3T represents a refined choice for those seeking a luxury sedan that combines performance with sophisticated design and technology.

- Prestige Package with premium amenities
- V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and RWD
- Heated and ventilated front seats with Nappa leather seating surfaces
- Surround View Monitor for enhanced parking visibility
- Heads-Up Display (HUD) for driver convenience
- Power moonroof for open-air driving
- Wireless device charging pad with Qi standard
- 19-inch alloy wheels
- Navigation system with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay integration
- Heated steering wheel and heated rear seats
- Rain-sensing wipers with automatic high-beam headlights
- Premium Lexicon audio system with 15 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio
- Forward and reverse parking distance warning
- Power trunk with remote operation

The exterior presents a striking black finish that conveys elegance and presence on the road. With 64,824 miles on the odometer, this G70 has been well-maintained and remains in excellent condition. The black exterior pairs seamlessly with the sophisticated interior appointments included in the Prestige Package.

Inside, you'll find a driver-focused cabin designed with attention to detail. The Nappa leather seating surfaces with luxury quilting provide comfort for daily commutes and longer journeys alike. The heated and ventilated front seats adjust to your preferences, while heated rear seats ensure passenger comfort during colder months. The microfiber suede headliner adds a touch of refinement to the cabin environment.

The technology suite in this G70 enhances both convenience and safety. The Heads-Up Display projects essential driving information directly into your line of sight, eliminating the need to look away from the road. The Surround View Monitor provides a comprehensive view around the vehicle, making parking and tight maneuvers more manageable. Wireless device charging keeps your phone powered throughout the day, while seamless integration with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay connects you to your digital life.

Performance and efficiency are balanced thoughtfully in this sedan. The V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive power when you need it, achieving 17 city and 26 highway MPG. The rear-wheel-drive configuration provides a balanced driving experience suitable for various road conditions.

Safety and convenience features throughout the vehicle work together to support confident driving. Forward and reverse parking distance warnings alert you to obstacles, while the comprehensive airbag system and electronic stability control provide comprehensive protection. The power trunk, heated steering wheel, and rain-sensing wipers represent the thoughtful touches that make ownership more enjoyable.

This 2020 Genesis G70 3.3T is ready to welcome its next owner. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the quality and refinement this luxury sedan offers firsthand.

This 2020 Toyota Camry Hybrid SE represents an excellent choice for drivers seeking reliability, efficiency, and contemporary comfort in a midsize sedan.

- 2.5L I4 DOHC 16V Hybrid Engine with eCVT
- 44 City / 47 Highway MPG
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Power Driver Seat with Lumbar Support
- Sport Steering Wheel with Mounted Audio Controls
- Rear Exterior Parking Camera
- Toyota Safety Connect with 1-Year Trial
- 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS
- Dual Front and Side Impact Airbags plus Knee and Overhead Airbags
- Front Sport Bucket Seats with SofTex Fabric
- 18-Inch Black Machined-Finish Alloy Wheels

The cabin features front sport bucket seats upholstered in durable SofTex fabric, complemented by a power driver seat that allows personalized positioning for long commutes. The sport steering wheel with integrated audio controls keeps essential functions within easy reach, while the telescoping and tilt adjustment ensures proper driver ergonomics.

Climate management comes through dual-zone automatic temperature control, allowing front passenger and driver to maintain individual comfort preferences. The rear window defroster enhances visibility during inclement weather, and variably intermittent wipers adapt to changing precipitation levels.

Safety features include four-wheel independent suspension paired with speed-sensing steering for confident handling. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain grip during challenging conditions. Toyota's Safety Connect emergency communication system with a one-year trial provides additional peace of mind, while the comprehensive airbag system includes front, side, knee, and overhead protection.

This silver Camry Hybrid SE is ready for immediate inspection and test drive at our showroom.

Technology integration enhances your journey with SYNC 3, offering voice-activated touchscreen navigation without the need for phone mounting. The Sony stereo system with 12 speakers and SiriusXM radio reception ensures quality entertainment, while steering wheel mounted controls keep your focus on the road. Multiple airbags and an electronic stability control system work together to support your safety.

This well-equipped Titanium model presents an opportunity to own a midsize sedan that balances practical daily utility with the refinements expected of its class. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand.

This 2025 Kia K4 LXS in Snow White Pearl represents an excellent opportunity to own a well-maintained sedan backed by Kia's certified pre-owned program. With just over 15,000 miles, this vehicle has been meticulously inspected and is ready to deliver reliable performance for years to come.

This sedan delivers smart efficiency with its 2.0L four-cylinder engine, offering 29 MPG in the city and 39 MPG on the highway. The continuously variable transmission provides smooth acceleration while maximizing fuel economy—a practical choice for daily driving. You'll appreciate the responsive power steering, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and electronic stability control that work together to keep you confident on any road.

The cabin is designed for comfort and connectivity. The 12.3-inch touchscreen audio display integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected during your commute. Climate control, heated door mirrors, and a telescoping steering wheel ensure you can adjust your driving position to suit your needs. The split folding rear seat offers flexibility for passengers or cargo, while six speakers with SiriusXM radio provide quality audio entertainment throughout your journey.

- 3 month Sirius trial subscription

This Kia K4 has been thoroughly evaluated and carries Kia Certified Pre-Owned status, which means you're purchasing with confidence. The clean CARFAX history as a one-owner vehicle demonstrates consistent, responsible ownership. Safety features including dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, rear side impact airbags, and an occupant sensing system provide multiple layers of protection for you and your passengers.

The exterior styling is clean and contemporary, with body-color bumpers and 16-inch dark gray alloy wheels that complement the Snow White Pearl finish. Variably intermittent wipers and fully automatic headlights add practical convenience, while delay-off headlights ensure visibility as you depart from evening locations.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this 2025 Kia K4 LXS firsthand. Our team is prepared to answer your questions and discuss financing options that work for your situation. This certified pre-owned sedan offers reliability, efficiency, and a comprehensive warranty package—everything you need in a dependable daily driver.
